commit_message:
build(site): bump Astro from ^5.0.0 to ^7.1.0

Upgrade Astro dependency to the v7 line and regenerate package-lock.json accordingly. Lockfile picks up the new native compiler-binding packages and satteri-based markdown pipeline that replace the old @astrojs/markdown-remark/remark-* toolchain.

Confidence: medium
Scope-risk: moderate
Not-tested: site build/dev server not run against the new Astro version

findings.issue: astro major bump ^5.0.0 to ^7.1.0, two major versions. Breaking changes likely (config, markdown/prism internals renamed per lockfile: astro-compiler-binding replaces astro-compiler, markdown-satteri replaces markdown-remark).
findings.fix: Build+preview site locally, check astro migration guide v5 to v7 before merge.

findings.issue: Large lockfile churn from major bump, unreviewed transitive dependency tree change (new native binding packages, new install-time deps).
findings.fix: Run npm install / npm ci and confirm site builds clean, check for new postinstall scripts in added packages.

historical.message:
fix(site): upgrade astro 5->7 to clear dependabot alerts

Bump astro 5.18.2 -> 7.1.3, clearing all 9 open dependabot alerts on
the marketing site (8 astro XSS/SSRF advisories + 1 esbuild dev-server
file-read). Astro 7 pulled a vulnerable sharp <0.35.0 (libvips CVEs);
npm audit fix bumped it. npm audit now reports 0 vulnerabilities.

Practical exposure of the original alerts was near-nil: static output,
no SSR adapter, no user input, esbuild dev-only. This is hygiene to
close the alerts. Verified: astro build exit 0, all 3 pages generated.

Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: no visual/browser check; static build output only
